newsitem.title: USA: PLC Systems target of class action.
newsitem.headline: PLC Systems target of class action.

text.p: A securities fraud class action suit has been filed against PLC Systems Inc, whose shares lost half their value this week after a federal advisory committee voted to reject the company's Heart Laser System.
The firm of Berman, DeValerio & Pease LLP said Friday that they started action against the company in U.S. District Court for the District of Massachusetts.
The suit covers those who bought PLC stock from February 13, 1997 through July 28.

The firm said their action alleges that PLC, its chairman Robert Rudko and its chief executive Max Lee Hibbs provided misleading information and omitted other information involving clinical trial results of the company's heart product.
"We have yet to be served with the suit so we cannot comment at this time," PLC spokeswoman Michele Fasano said. "We're not surprised, but we're obviously disappointed."
On Thursday the company said the U.S. Food and Drug Administration panel's decision was a "temporary setback" and said it plans to submit data to the agency as soon as possible.
